summary: Code shown as code: a name in a sentence, a command to run, a block to paste. Commands and blocks scroll rather than wrap, are named regions a keyboard can scroll, and carry a CopyButton that copies all of it.
useWhen: the user will run, paste or type what is shown — a CLI command, an API request, a config file
a sentence names something the user types exactly — a flag, a file name, a command — and it should read as code

useInstead.when: the value is an ID or key shown among other facts, not code
useInstead.why: an ID beside its label in a DescriptionList reads as a fact; a snippet's block around it reads as something to run
keys are pressed, not typed; Kbd draws each key and never prints a plus between them

useInstead.when: an agent's tool input or output
useInstead.why: it shows the payload with the call it belongs to, its status and duration, collapsed until asked for

composition.note: `children` is the code as a string, shown and copied exactly as given. `type` picks inline, single or multi; `label` names a single or multi block, and `copyLabel` its copy button when there is more than one on a page.
composition.example: <CodeSnippet label="Start command" copyLabel="Copy start command">iops runs start --agent invoice-reconciler</CodeSnippet>

single.use: the default — one command, scrolling sideways if it is long

multi.use: a block — a request, a config; cut to `maxLines` with Show more

inline.use: in a sentence; no copy button

requires: `label` on each single or multi snippet when a page has more than one — "Start command"; the default is "Code"
`copyLabel` naming what is copied when a page has more than one — "Copy start command"; the default is "Copy code"
guarantees: single and multi are focusable regions named by `label`, so the arrow keys scroll what is off screen
code never wraps: single stays one line, 32px tall, and scrolls sideways; multi scrolls sideways line by line
a multi block longer than `maxLines` is cut by height, not by dropping lines: every line is in the page and found by find-in-page
Show more is a Button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` pointing at the region; it becomes Show less
the copy button is a CopyButton: it copies the whole text, cut or not, confirms on the button and announces
a trailing newline is not counted as a line
inline is a <code> in the sentence, with no region and no button
notes: never put a secret in a snippet unless the user must copy it now; redact it everywhere else, as ToolCall's payloads are
`language` only sets `language-<name>` on the <code>; IonBase does not highlight, and a highlighter added on top must keep the text readable against `surface/muted`

antiPatterns.why: a wrapped command reads as two, and a hand-built <pre> that scrolls is not focusable, so a keyboard cannot reach what is off screen

antiPatterns.dont: a multi block cut to its first lines with the rest dropped
antiPatterns.why: dropped lines are missed by find-in-page, by a screen reader and by a copy that copies what is shown

antiPatterns.dont: <CodeSnippet type="inline"> for a command the user will copy
antiPatterns.why: inline has no copy button, and a command selected by hand from a sentence picks up the full stop
